Class SysMLPort.UDPReceiver

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.ports.SysMLPort.UDPReceiver
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
Enclosing class:
SysMLPort
public class SysMLPort.UDPReceiver extends Object implements Runnable
The UDPReceiver is a Runnable class that receives objects from UDPTransmitters via the User Datagram Protocol (UDP). It is used by SysMLPort instances to execute interactions betwen ports that reside in separate PartContainers, i.e. in separate JVM processes.

The SysMLPort is configured for inter-process port interactions by simply using the constructor that specifies the port's internet address and UDP port number. This constructor will instantiate the UDPReceiver to receive and/or transmit signals via the UDP protocol from/to a "remote" full-port. The full-port must also be "connected" to the remote port via a call to the addConnectedPortPeer() method where the port to be added is an instance of a SysMLPort that is likewise instantiated with an internet address and UDP port number. See the PartContainer for more details.

Modelers typically will not need to reference the UDPReceiver in any way as its instantiation and operation are automatically configured when the SysMLPort is extended and constructed in this way.
